findings.evidence: TypeB.lean:142-160 vs TypeD.lean:99-119 are identical modulo JB/JD, including the `simpa [hB] using (isAdjointPair_toLinearMap₂ ...)` call with the same four named arguments; a third copy of the same argument for `toLinearMap₂'` is at TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Standard.lean:68-81.
findings.fix: Prove once, e.g. in TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/SkewAdjoint.lean: `theorem mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra_toMatrix_iff (c : Module.Basis n K V) (B : BilinForm K V) {J} (hJ : BilinForm.toMatrix c B = J) (f : Module.End K V) : LinearMap.toMatrix c c f ∈ skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra J ↔ f ∈ skewAdjointLieSubalgebra B` and the resulting `skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra J ≃ₗ⁅K⁆ skewAdjointLieSubalgebra B`, then obtain both `typeBSkewAdjointEquiv` and `typeDSkewAdjointEquiv` by instantiating at `polarBilin_toMatrix_typeBBasis` / `polarBilin_toMatrix_typeDBasis`, deleting the duplicated proofs in TypeD.lean.
findings.issue: `mem_typeB_toMatrix_iff`, `typeBSkewAdjointEquiv`, `typeBSkewAdjointEquiv_apply` (138-181) and `typeBQuadraticEquiv`/`typeBQuadraticEquiv_lie_ι` (194-210) are TypeD.lean:95-141 and 154-171 with JD/typeD/typeDBasis replaced by JB/typeB/typeBBasis. Neither proof uses anything about the polarization or the matrix beyond `BilinForm.toMatrix c Q.polarBilin = J`, so a special case is re-proved instead of the general statement.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:104 `lineCoordinate_sq : ∀ z : line, lineCoordinate z * lineCoordinate z = Q z`; TypeB.lean:67 uses `hz` only for surjectivity of `lineCoordinate` and TypeB.lean:116 only via `← P.lineCoordinate_sq, hz`. The module docstring at TypeB.lean:21-22 states the normalization as polar self-pairing `2`, i.e. `Q z = 1`.
findings.fix: Replace the hypothesis by `hz : Q (z : V) = 1` throughout (`lineEquiv` surjectivity: `(a * P.lineCoordinate z) • z`; line 115-116 then closes with `polar_self` and `hz` directly).
findings.issue: `hz : P.lineCoordinate z = 1` is stronger than what the file uses: `lineCoordinate_sq` turns `Q z = 1` into `lineCoordinate z * lineCoordinate z = 1`, which already makes `lineEquiv` surjective, and the only other use of `hz` is the Gram entry `polar Q z z = 2 • Q z = 2`. The stronger form rules out `lineCoordinate z = -1` and phrases the hypothesis in terms of an internal structure field rather than `Q`.

summary: The skew-adjoint matrix-to-endomorphism transport is copied verbatim from TypeD.lean with JD replaced by JB, when the argument depends only on `BilinForm.toMatrix c Q.polarBilin = J` and should be proved once for a general Gram matrix. The coordinate-one hypothesis is also stronger than the intrinsic `Q z = 1` the proofs actually use.
